# clio backup verify

Re-check one archive's digests and its payload's validity; --db and --backend are refused because they cannot change the verdict

## Usage

```
clio backup verify ID | clio backup verify --latest [--output json|text]
```

## Description

reads the archive, not a store, so --db and --backend are refused because they cannot change the verdict; it re-reads the payload and the key member, compares both with the manifest, and asks each backend's own payload check whether the payload is valid

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ID` | yes | Snapshot id from the backup directory's listing; `restore` restores that archive and `verify` re-checks it. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--latest` |  |  | Selects the newest listed snapshot instead of a positional id; `backup_verify_cli::resolve_id` resolves it. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Re-check one snapshot's digests and payload.
```
clio backup verify clio-20260910T002640Z-0a1b2c3d
```

Verify a second listed snapshot.
```
clio backup verify clio-20260910T002700Z-1b2c3d4e
```

Verify one snapshot and print the verdict as JSON.
```
clio backup verify clio-20260910T002640Z-0a1b2c3d -o json
```
